sloka: इह शीघ्रं सुपर्वाणो ज्वलितास्या इवोरगाः ।इषवो निपतिष्यन्ति रामलक्ष्मणलक्षणाः ।। ५.१९.२१।।।।
transliteration: iha śīghraṁ suparvāṇo jvalitāsyā ivoragāḥ ।iṣavo nipatiṣyanti rāmalakṣmaṇalakṣaṇāḥ ।। 5.19.21।।।।

translations.english: She was wasted and emaciated through fasting and grief, depressed due to brooding and threatenings. She ate very little but was rich with austerities.
